entries.zh: 需索；勒索、骗取（他人）钱财
entries.en: to swindle him of his money; to extort money from someone

entries.zh: 索取；强行索要（以骗取为目的）
entries.en: to demand and take; to extort what is not due

entries.zh: 索骗；借索要为名行骗、骗取财物
entries.en: to swindle by (false) demands; to cheat and extort

entries.zh: 引路行骗；诳人引路而使其落网受骗
entries.en: to deceive by leading (a person) along so that he be caught
entries.notes: 汉字第三字（御）与 M 音 sáy、R 音 zhū 不合，西语 bilante 难解；据 engañar…para que prenda（诱引入彀）推拟。

entries.en: to incite and beguile; to stir up and deceive (minds)

entries.zh: 骗子；俗语「剃人后毛」——把人剃净挖光，喻敲剥净尽
entries.en: swindler; lit. "shave a man and pluck his hair" — to fleece him bare
entries.notes: 西语栏字迹难辨、M 栏首字音 T99（污損難辨）；释义据 H「剃人后挖毛」与 R 音推拟。

entries.zh: 张局行骗；设局设套诳人
entries.en: to deceive by laying a trick or plot
entries.notes: 汉字「句」疑为「局」之讹；西语 treça 按旧义 treta（诡计）释，均属推断。

entries.zh: 创局行骗；起局设套（西语并及假买卖行骗）
entries.en: to deceive by contriving a plot, e.g. a sham purchase
entries.notes: 西语 conpracon 疑为 compración（买卖）一类词之讹写，难确证；「句」同上疑为「局」。

entries.zh: 瞒天；欺天瞒人的老辣骗术（参「瞒天过海」式惯骗）
entries.en: to deceive heaven itself — brazen, consummate deceit; a hardened swindler
to beget, to give birth to; to grow
the birth of a son (classical idiom "playing with the jade sceptre"); to beget and bear a son

entries.zh: 晚生子；老来得子（老妪受孕生产）
entries.en: to beget late in life; a late-born child
entries.notes: M/R 栏多出两音节（chiēn guar／lēng gue）未解，音节数与汉字数不合；释义以 H「晚生子」与西语 a la vieja（老妪）为准。
汉字与 M/R 两音栏皆空；仅西语词头 Engrandecer（使壮大、显扬）可读，无从互证。
汉字「稍」与 M 音 pue³、R 音 gui 互不合，R 栏无调号疑误读；仅西语词头 Engrudar（涂糊、裱贴）可读，无从互证。
M 栏第二音节 ŝeabole 未解、疑污损；释义依 H「漿」与 R「chiāng」及西语 engrudo。

entries.zh: 漿洗；浆洗衣物所用之浆（淀粉浆糊）
entries.notes: 西语 salmidon 为 el almidón（淀粉）连读之拆分，属展开推断；M 栏内又见 almidon 字样，栏界杂糅。
西语例句 mançana（苹果/街坊）与糊义关联不明；释义以 H「薄漿」及 M/R 音为准。

entries.zh: 糊好置于该处；涂糊到位
entries.en: to paste it and put it in place (here)
entries.notes: 汉字「帶處」义未明、M 音（ã/ẽ）未解；据西语 engrudarlo…ponlo aquí（糊好放在这里）推拟。
